Scope and known limits

This is a walking-only test. The connected painting bends over a weighted mesh; its upper body stays close to its painted rest pose, avoiding separate shoulder and neck cutouts. The walk has a shorter stride, lower foot lift, and straighter supporting leg. Bags remain separate props.

Clothing can still stretch and the arms are deliberately restrained. A broader test distorted the painting during large reaches, so this method has not replaced the door or flower interactions. Those need better prepared, separately layered artwork and more careful skin weighting. This is not proof of finished animation quality.
